chunks: My father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan narrated to me from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Nuʿaym ibn al-Walīd, from Yūsuf al-Kunāsī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

When you go to the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), go to the Euphrates and perform a ritual bath opposite his grave, then turn toward him with calmness and dignity until you enter the Ḥāʾir (enclosure) from its eastern side.

And upon entering, recite: Peace be upon the high-ranked angels of Allah, peace be upon the descending angels of Allah, peace be upon the angels who come in succession, peace be upon the distinguished angels of Allah, peace be upon the angels who reside in this enclosure by Allah's permission.

When you face the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), recite: Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessing be upon Muḥammad, the Trustee of Allah over His messengers and His firmly determined affairs, the seal of what has passed and the opener of what is to come, and the master over all of it. Peace be upon him and the mercy and blessings of Allah.

Then say: Peace be upon the Commander of the Believers, Your slave and the brother of Your Messenger, whom You chose with Your knowledge and made a guide for whomever You willed from among Your creation, the guide to those with whom You sent Your messages, the ruler of the religion by Your justice, the decisive judge between Your creation, and the master over all of it. Peace be upon him and the mercy and blessings of Allah.

O Allah, send blessings upon al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAli, Your slave and the son of Your Messenger, whom You chose with Your knowledge... until the end of what You sent blessings upon the Commander of the Believers.
Then send peace upon al-Ḥusayn and the rest of the Imams, just as You sent blessings and peace upon al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAli.

Then you approach the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) and say: Peace be upon you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh; peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessing be upon you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh; may Allah have mercy on you, O Abā ʿAbdillāh.

I testify that you conveyed from Allah that which He commanded you, and you did not fear anyone but Him, and you strove in His path and worshipped Him truthfully and sincerely until certainty (death) came to you.
I testify that you are the word of piety, the door of guidance, the strongest handhold, and the proof upon those who remain and those who are under the earth.
I testify that this was your precedent in what has passed and your opener in what remains.
I testify that your souls and your clay are a blessed clay that was purified and made pure, one from the other, by favor from Allah and His mercy.
So I call Allah and you as witnesses that I believe in you and am certain of your return, and I follow you in my self, the rulings of my religion, the conclusion of my deeds, my return, and my abode.
So I ask Allah, the Kind, the Merciful, to complete this for me.
And I testify that you conveyed from Allah that which He commanded you, until you did not fear anyone but Him, and you strove in His path and worshipped Him until certainty came to you.
May Allah curse those who killed you, and may Allah curse those who ordered it, and may Allah curse those who heard of it and were pleased with it.
I testify that those who violated your sanctity and spilled your blood are cursed by the tongue of the Unlettered Prophet.
Then say: O Allah, curse those who changed Your blessings, opposed Your religion, turned away from Your command, accused Your Messenger, and diverted from Your path.
O Allah, fill their graves with fire and their cavities with fire, and gather them and their followers to Hell while blind.
O Allah, curse them with a curse by which every high-ranked angel, every sent prophet, and every believer whose heart You tested with faith will curse them.
O Allah, curse them in the depth of secrecy and the face of openness.

O Allah, curse the Jibts and Taghuts of this nation, and curse their pharaohs, and curse the killers of the Commander of the Believers, and curse the killers of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, and torment them with a painful punishment.
Which You do not punish anyone else from among the worlds with.
O Allah, make us among those whom You support and who support You, and favor them with Your victory for Your religion in this world and the Hereafter.

Then sit by his head (peace be upon him) and say: May Allah bless you. I testify that you are Allah's slave and His Trustee, you conveyed with loyalty, fulfilled faithfully, were killed as truthful, and departed upon certainty.
You did not prefer blindness over guidance, nor did you turn from truth to falsehood.

I testify that you established prayer, gave alms-tax, enjoined good, forbade evil, followed the Messenger, recited the Book with true recitation, and called to the path of your Lord with wisdom and good counsel.
May Allah bless you and send peace with abundant peace.
I testify that you were upon clear proof from your Lord, you conveyed what you were ordered and fulfilled its right, and you confirmed those before you without weakness or languor.
May Allah bless you and send peace. May Allah reward you, O most truthful one, with good on behalf of your nation.

I testify that Jihad is with you, and that Truth is with you and leads to you, and you are its people and its source, and the inheritance of prophethood is with you and with your family (peace be upon them).
I testify that you are the most truthful one with Allah and His proof upon His creation.
And I testify that your call is truth, and every caller appointed other than you is false and cast aside.
And I testify that Allah is the Manifest Truth.
Then move to his feet and choose from supplications and pray for yourself.

Then move to the head of ʿAli ibn al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) and say: Peace of Allah, and peace of His high-ranked angels, and peace of His sent prophets be upon you, O my master and son of my master, and the mercy and blessings of Allah.
May Allah bless you and your family and the offspring of your righteous fathers, those from whom Allah removed impurity and purified them with a thorough purification.
Then you go to the graves of the martyrs and send peace upon them and say: Peace be upon you, O godly men.
You are our predecessors and forerunners, and we are your followers and supporters.
I testify that you are Allah's supporters, as Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said in His Book: 'And many a prophet fought with him innumerable godly men.'
So they did not lose heart for what befell them in the path of Allah, nor did they weaken, nor did they humble themselves.
So you did not lose heart, nor did you weaken, nor did you humble yourselves, until you met Allah upon the path of truth and the victory of Allah's complete word.
May Allah bless your souls and bodies and send peace.
Rejoice in the promise of Allah which has no failure; indeed, He does not fail the promise.
Allah will attain for you vengeance for that which He promised you.
You are the masters of the martyrs in this world and the Hereafter.
You are the forerunners, the migrants, and the supporters.
I testify that you strove in the path of Allah and were killed upon the tradition of the Messenger of Allah and the son of His Messenger.
Praise be to Allah who fulfilled His promise to you and showed you that which you love.
Then say: I have come to you, O beloved of the Messenger of Allah and son of His Messenger.
And I am aware of you, and acknowledge your right, and see your merit, and am certain of the deviation of those who opposed you.
Aware of the guidance upon which you are; may my father, mother, and self be sacrificed for you.
O Allah, I send blessings upon him just as You sent blessings upon him, and Your messengers, and the Commander of the Believers.
A continuous, connected, successive blessing, one following another, with no break, no end, no eternity, and no limit.
In our presence here, and when we are absent and present.
And peace be upon him, and the mercy and blessings of Allah.

key_terms.الْحَائِر: The enclosure or courtyard surrounding the shrine

ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step ritual for performing the Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This foundational text from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the theological framework of Shia visitation by linking the physical act of pilgrimage to the spiritual lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing the continuity of prophetic truth through the Imams. It integrates specific liturgical formulas that affirm the Imams' role as the 'Word of Piety' and 'Proof of God,' while also invoking the concept of *Tawalli* (loyalty) and *Tafaddul* (disavowal) through detailed blessings and curses. The ritual structure, moving from purification at the Euphrates to specific salutations at the head and feet of the Imam, reflects the Shia emphasis on bodily reverence as an extension of inner conviction.
